title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-notes
body:
Purpose: sync across serving-runtime + infra + console teams. Quick status, unblock items, track action items. Draft notes for Tues weekly (standing 10:00am PT).

Attendees (planned):
- Aisha (owner, runtime)
- Miguel (infra)
- Samir (console)
- Jolie (SRE)
- Optional: Priya (dedicated), Dan (product)

Goals for this week:
- Confirm canary rollout plan for v0.9.3 kernels (runtime)
- Validate autoscaler tuning changes on staging (infra)
- Console: wire up new rollout UI for canary percentages + fallback policies
- Identify highest-risk regressions from last perf window and assign mitigations

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick rundowns (5m each team)
  - Runtime: canary status, perf diffs, known regressions
  - Infra: cluster capacity, failed nodes, autoscaler behavior
  - Console: UI changes, telemetry, rollout APIs
2) Blockers & escalations (8m)
3) Action item review & owners (10m)
4) AOB / sync points with product/security (2m)

Notes / Updates (live):
- Runtime (Aisha):
  - v0.9.3 kernel build completed on staging; running perf harness overnight. Initial 95th latency +4% on long-context jobs (seq>2048) — investigating whether kernel selection logic regressed.
  - Investigate: KV-cache eviction change in PR #782 might be related (see linked PR).
  - Canary target: start 2% traffic tomorrow to avoid compounding latency — need infra to reserve capacity.

- Infra (Miguel):
  - Autoscaler tuning applied to staging (lower CPU trigger from 70%->60%, increase ramp window). Observing less oscillation but need 48h baseline.
  - Two preemptible nodes failed on us-east-1a last night; SRE restarted jobs and moved canary instances to us-east-1b. Root cause suspected provider instability; filing incident postmortem draft.
  - Capacity ask: reserve 4 GPUs for runtime canary tomorrow 10am-2pm.

- Console (Samir):
  - Rollout UI prototype merged to feature branch; needs API contract finalization. Frontend can pass canary_percentage + fallback_model_id.
  - Telemetry: added per-route trace IDs for rollouts; missing token-level cost breakdown for canary traffic (Jolie to help).

Blockers / Open questions:
- Who signs off on rollbacks if canary shows regressions? Need on-call + product quick decision tree. (Owner: Dan / product)
- Root cause of latency regression unclear: kernel selection vs kv-cache eviction. Prioritize reproducer on staging sequence distribution. (Owner: Aisha + Miguel)
- Console needs a mock endpoint for fallback responses to test UI flows. (Owner: Samir)

Action items (tracking):
- AI-1: Reproduce latency regression with synthetic long-context job on staging, capture perf profile and kernel selection path. Owner: Aisha. Due: 2026-03-01. Status: in_progress.
- AI-2: Reserve 4 GPUs us-east-1b for canary window 2026-03-02 10:00-14:00; coordinate with on-call. Owner: Miguel. Due: 2026-03-01. Status: todo.
- AI-3: Draft rollback decision tree for canary regressions; include thresholds (95th latency increase >10% OR error rate >1%). Owner: Dan (prod) + Jolie (SRE). Due: 2026-03-03. Status: in_review.
- AI-4: Add mock fallback endpoint and minimal schema for console UI testing; return deterministic payloads for validation. Owner: Samir. Due: 2026-03-02. Status: todo.
- AI-5: Add token-level cost telemetry for canary traffic into retention window; small schema change in telemetry pipeline. Owner: Jolie. Due: 2026-03-05. Status: todo.

Personal notes / scratchpad (Aisha):
- Quick checklist before canary: run nightly perf harness, confirm autoscaler history is stable 48h, ensure fallback model available and tested, communicate to infra on-call.
- Questions to raise in 1:1 with Miguel: what is the rollback cadence if infra capacity causes partial canary? do we have capacity reservations in place?
- Reminder: follow up on PR #782 comment from Sam (kv eviction) — Sam suggested a small optimization to keep cold-start behavior but changed LRU policy; might need revert.
- Risks: if kernel selection continues to pick suboptimal kernels for seq>2048 we might need a hotfix roll-forward (patch) rather than full rollback. Prepare a cherry-pick plan.

Parking lot (non-blocking):
- Longer-term: telemetry dashboard for rollout quality (latency delta, cost delta, quality regressions vs eval prompts). Keep as product backlog item.
- Model quantization experiments: slot into next sprint planning (eng-research).

Next sync (tentative): 2026-03-03 10:00am PT — update action item statuses and decision on canary start.

Quick links / references I mentioned:
- Perf harness: github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness (ticket: ENG-4010)
- PR #782: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/782
- Incident draft: confluence.redwood/incident/2026-02-26-us-east-preemptible

Notes for follow-up:
- If AI-1 reproducer shows kernel selection issue, prioritize bisecting commit range between kernels v0.9.1..v0.9.3.
- If infra cannot reserve GPUs, postpone canary to next window and communicate to product + customers impacted.

----
Quick shorthand (for Slack post after sync):
- Runtime canary planned for 2026-03-02 10:00 PT (2% traffic) pending infra capacity + final perf check.
- Action items: Aisha (reproducer), Miguel (reserve GPUs), Samir (fallback endpoint), Dan+Jolie (rollback decision tree).
